display_name: F跨RX50弱发射机：浅中层随机与显著通道挑战
description: Two initial scratch50 candidates on exact original F+CROSS_RX50; source-fixed weak TX only, shallow/mid12.5% channel challenge with matched random control. NO satellite; clean only; default head jointly trained on original objective. Candidate auxiliary freezes existing W, no new classifier/params.
authorization: Active user worse-transmitter feature-learning goal; local, no satellite augmentation/test, default head joint. Source feature geometry motivates a generic all-class margin, no target class-specific rule.

notes: Exact original F+CROSS_RX50=33L+17U,11100 real updates; ordinaryAug,LS.01,RDrop1,oldgate-ownEMA-cos,unified physical Sinc. No satellite; clean168000 only; default head main jointly trained.

Weak indices1/3 (14-7,20-19) fixed by prior sourceV calibration. No target-conditioned sample selection or mask. SourceV geometry suggests close class centroids; feature-margin and extra joint SupCon did not jointly solve weak classes. This separate hypothesis tests alternative usable features, not stronger repulsion or more U.

Reference RSC: https://github.com/DeLightCMU/RSC . Adaptation is source-fixed weak-only, shallow/mid channel mask, auxiliary CE with detached existing W; do not claim canonical RSC reproduction or invention.

Firstseed two arms run concurrently, source freeze for BOTH before any new candidate target. Each arm independently follows unchanged fixed source expansion criterion; failed arms retain n1 with clean test. Reuse matching original50 local BASE controls, no retraining or re-prediction.

Every4 updates after step1110, alternate48channel time_down and96channel t2.pool. Remove exactly6/12 channels for each current weak L sample.2498 calls split1249each. Max coefficient.1 with warm5/ramp10. Private mask RNG; no change to main RNG or original two RDrop/SupCon forwards. Extra identity forward eval/cloned buffers/existing W detached; actual feature gradients verified.

Independent truth-last CPU scorer opens truth only after exact clean predictions complete. No satellite/LEO, no separately fit head. Report eachseed,mean/sampleSD,paired weak/perTX/RX/day/cost and preserve negatives. Benchmark already exposed, no new blind-test claim.

New local immutable release/output; GPU0 max3 total including other owners, RAM>=4.5GiB, scorer max1. No healthy process changes or automated retry. One focused review only; checks already PASS with real final50 discarded checkpoint zero-input smoke.
